column3: \t\t２２０／９／ケッセルリンク／戦闘後　実行後
column4: 220/9/Kesselring/ After combat execution

column3: \t\tメイド達がランスに捕獲される、８人揃った後
column4: After the maids are captured by Rance, when all eight have gathered.

column3: \t\tとんでもないレアイベント
column4: An extraordinary rare event.

column3: \t\tランス城、ランスの僕として過ごすメイド達。
column4: At Rance Castle, the maids live serving as Rance's servants.

column3: \t\tある時、ランスとケッセルリンクの話になる
column4: One day, a conversation arises about Rance and Kesselring.

column3: \t\tケッセルリンクを復活させて欲しい・・いずれなとその気のないランス
column4: They want Kesselring to be revived... but Rance has no intention of doing so anytime soon.

column3: \t\tそんな時、ケッセルリンクがカラーと知る。
column4: At that time, it is discovered that Kesselring is from Kalar.

column3: \t\tカラーに男はいない、どうしてだ。
column4: There are no men in Kalar; why is that?

column3: \t\tあの方は女性を守る為に男に性転換をした。
column4: That person changed sex to male in order to protect women.

column3: \t\t女だったら復活させたのに・・とランス・・・
column4: Rance says, 'If she had been a woman, I would have revived her...'

column3: \t\t復活したら、性転換前に戻っているかもしれませんよと誰か・・
column4: Someone says, 'If revived, she might return to her pre-sex change form.'

column3: \t\tよし、復活させようと決意　＝　安易な考えのランス君
column4: Alright, I've decided to revive her - the easily made decision of Rance.

column3: \t\tなんらかの儀式して復活させる。
column4: Perform some kind of ritual to resurrect her.

column3: \t\tケッセルリンクは蘇った、期待通り女の姿
column4: Kesselring was revived, appearing as a woman as expected.

column3: \t\tランスに対して復活させてくれた事は感謝するが
column4: She expresses gratitude to Rance for reviving her,

column3: \t\tすぐに男に性転換して女達を守ると宣言
column4: But immediately declares she will change back to male and protect the women.

column3: \t\tそれは駄目だとランス、女達を守るのは俺の役目だ。
column4: Rance says that's not allowed; protecting the women is his role.

column3: \t\tお前がそれを願うのなら、その立場を競ってまた戦う事になるだろう
column4: If you desire that, we will have to compete for that position and fight again.

column3: \t\t・・・ランスとやら、お前は本当に女達を不幸にしないのか
column4: ...Rance, are you truly not going to bring misfortune to the women?

column3: \t\tもちろんだ。
column4: Of course not.

column3: \t\t・・よかろう、少し様子を見させてもらう
column4: ...Very well, I will observe for a while.

column3: \t\tだいたい、こんなノリでケッセルリンク女が仲間になる
column4: Somehow, with this sort of vibe, the female Kesselring becomes an ally.
